title: Notice and Lockout Terms of the Keyturn Host Payout Account
content:
Moving a Keyturn Host Payout Account onto another schedule, and changing the deposit details or the payout method on it, each run to a notice period and a lockout period set by the schedule.

## Terms by schedule

| Payout schedule | Notice to change schedule | Days from notice to effect | Lockout after moving to a slower schedule | Deposit detail change lockout | Payout method change lockout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | 0 days | 7 days | 30 days | 3 days | 30 days |
| Weekly Batch | 7 days | 7 days | 30 days | 3 days | 30 days |
| Express | 7 days | 5 days | 60 days | 5 days | 30 days |
| Instant | 7 days | 5 days | 60 days | 7 days | 45 days |
| Fleet Settlement | 30 days | 30 days | 180 days | 7 days | 60 days |
| Reserve-Backed Settlement | 30 days | 30 days | 180 days | 10 days | 90 days |

## The five periods

1. **Notice to change schedule** is the calendar days' notice to change payout schedule: none on the Keyturn Standard Payout Schedule, 7 days on the next three, and 30 days on the two settlement schedules.
2. **Days from notice to effect** is the calendar days after notice on which a schedule change takes effect.
3. **Lockout after moving to a slower schedule** is the calendar days before a host may move to a slower schedule again.
4. **Deposit detail change lockout** is the calendar days after a deposit detail change before money may leave again.
5. **Payout method change lockout** is the calendar days after changing payout method before it may be changed again.

A Keyturn Instant Payout Schedule account therefore gives 7 days' notice, sees the change take effect 5 days after the notice, waits 60 days before moving to a slower schedule again, is locked for 7 days after a deposit detail change and for 45 days after a payout method change.
